'''Kirba''', the Forgotten, was a mutated [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] residing in the [[Shrine of Silence]] on [[Voss]].<ref name="TOR:SoS" />

==History==
{{Quote|The subject continues to fight. He thinks this will earn him freedom, that he will break out of our control. He does not understand. We want him to fight. The subject curses us for offering him the gift of the dark side. He calls it 'the nightmares.' It is amusing. [...] He will see. He does not know the doom he faces. If he refuses the Force again, he will be obliterated.|A Sith alchemist|<ref name="TOR:KtF" />}}
During their occupation of [[Voss]], the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] many conducted experiments while on the planet. One of these involved exposing creatures with strong connections to the dark side to a Force-enriched world. Among these was a creature that would later be known as [[the Curse]] and a [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] named Kirba. However, when the newly evolved [[Voss (species)|Voss]] attacked and exterminated the Sith, the test subjects were left to themselves as the Sith structures fell into ruin. While the creature continued to thrive, changing to the point that whatever species it had once been could no longer be identified, and devouring and corrupting all around it,<ref name="TOR:KtF" /> Kirba remained in the room, separated from the rest of the area by a large chasm, where the Sith had once experimented on him and the creature. He spent his days strolling among the tables and devices, hoping to one day be free.<ref name="TOR:SoS" />

As millennia passed, the ruins became known to the local Voss as the [[Shrine of Silence]]. Eventually, Voss Mystics [[Rada-Ki]] and [[Tem-Su]] offered to survey the Shrine of Silence to contribute to reconstruction efforts following the [[Invasion of Voss]]. The [[Shrine Restoration Initiative]] were too preoccupied and were unable to answer their request, prompting them to set out on their own due to not wanting to continue waiting. The two were accompanied by a team of [[Voss commandos]] to the shrine, but they ultimately fell victim to the Curse's corruptions and were enslaved by it. Tem-Su's mother, [[Jiri-Su]], sent the [[Alliance Commander]] to rescue the Mystics. As they travelled through the Shrine, they solved a puzzle that gave them access to the old Sith lab and encountered Kirba, who believed he could kill them and earn his freedom. A Reality Disruption Instigator in the room allowed for Voss commandos that had been corrupted by the Curse to come to Kirba's aid against the Commander. However, Kirba was struck down and the Gormak yelled that it refused to die in the labs it had been abandoned in, promising the Commander that the Curse would be their end.<ref name="TOR:SoS" />
